name: Waifu School
source:
A romantic & sexy school visual novel mixed with an addicting match-3 puzzle. 10 cute girls are waiting for you...
You are the most popular playboy in highschool, hundred girls are crazy about you... but the story always ends up being the same, you are expelled from the school for convenience reason, and now.. you are moving to a new school in remote location. 
How will this story ends ?....

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/899630/Waifu_School/] Steam[/url]]
translation:
一款结合浪漫性感校园视觉小说与上瘾三消益智游戏的作品。10名可爱女孩在等你……你是高中最受欢迎的花花公子，百名女孩为你疯狂……但故事总是以同样方式结束：你因为某个方便的理由被学校开除，如今搬进了偏远地区的一所新学校。

这个故事会如何结束？

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/899630/Waifu_School/]Steam[/url]]
